import type { Order } from '../entities/Order';
import type { OrderStatus } from '../value-objects/OrderStatus';

/**
 * Stores orders. Loaded orders are independent copies: changes become visible
 * to other callers only once the order is saved.
 */
export interface OrderRepository {
  findById(id: string): Order | undefined;
  findAll(): Order[];
  findByStatus(status: OrderStatus): Order[];
  save(order: Order): void;
}
